items.title: Hackers Actively Attacking Cisco and Palo Alto Networks VPN Gateways to Gain Login Access
items.description: Threat actors launched a coordinated brute-force campaign against enterprise VPN gateways, hammering Palo Alto Networks GlobalProtect portals and Cisco SSL VPN endpoints with millions of automated login attempts in mid-December 2025.
